skill.name: copywriting
skill.description: Guides clear conversion-focused copy for homepages, landing pages, pricing pages, feature pages, about pages, and product pages.
skill.summary: Create and refine marketing page copy with structured sections, headlines, CTAs, and conversion rationale.
skill.author: coreyhaines31

content.value_statement: Marketing pages often sound vague and fail to guide visitors. This skill turns product context into clear page copy, CTAs, and section rationale.
actual_capabilities: Collects page purpose, audience, offer, proof, and traffic context before drafting.
Drafts sections for homepages, landing pages, pricing pages, feature pages, about pages, and product pages.
Creates headlines, subheadlines, CTAs, body copy, secondary CTAs, and SEO meta content.
Provides headline and CTA alternatives with rationale.
Applies guidance for social proof, objection handling, comparisons, testimonials, and final CTAs.
limitations: Does not verify customer claims, statistics, testimonials, or legal compliance.
Needs accurate audience, product, offer, and proof inputs for strong results.
Does not design page layouts or run conversion experiments.
Email sequences and popup copy are assigned to related skills.

use_cases.title: Launch a Landing Page
use_cases.description: Create a single-message page with headline, CTA, proof, objections, and final call to action.

use_cases.title: Improve a Pricing Page
use_cases.description: Clarify plans, reduce choice anxiety, and make the recommended option easier to understand.

use_cases.title: Refresh Product Messaging
use_cases.description: Turn feature lists into benefit-led sections that explain outcomes and differentiation.

prompt_templates.title: Draft Page Copy
prompt_templates.prompt: Write copy for a [page type] for [product]. Audience: [audience]. Primary action: [action]. Main benefit: [benefit]. Proof: [proof].
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Create a first draft from basic product context.

prompt_templates.title: Rewrite Existing Copy
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite this page copy for clarity and conversion. Keep the brand voice [voice]. Improve headline, subheadline, CTA, and body sections: [copy].
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Improve copy that already exists.

prompt_templates.title: Create Alternatives
prompt_templates.prompt: Create three headline and CTA options for [offer]. Explain the angle, audience fit, and strongest objection each option addresses.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Compare message angles before publishing or testing.

prompt_templates.title: Build Complete Page Narrative
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan and write a full landing page for [product]. Include problem, solution, proof, how it works, comparison, FAQ, final CTA, annotations, and SEO meta content.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Build a complete page with strategy and rationale.

output_examples.input: Landing page for reporting software used by agency account managers.
output_examples.output: Headline: Weekly client reports without the manual spreadsheet work. Subheadline: Connect your tools once and send clear updates every Monday. CTA: Create My First Report.

output_examples.input: Pricing page copy for a three-plan SaaS product.
output_examples.output: The output explains each plan by use case, highlights the recommended plan, and answers setup, cancellation, and team-size objections.

output_examples.input: Feature page for an analytics dashboard with competitor alternatives.
output_examples.output: The output connects dashboard features to user outcomes, adds proof points, and includes a comparison section focused on practical differences.

best_practices: Provide audience, traffic source, primary action, proof, and objections before asking for a draft.
Ask for headline and CTA alternatives when the page needs testing or stakeholder review.
Review every claim for accuracy before publishing.
anti_patterns: Requesting persuasive copy without explaining the target audience or offer.
Using fabricated statistics, testimonials, or urgency.
Asking for one generic message across different page types and visitor intents.

faq.question: What page types does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports homepages, landing pages, pricing pages, feature pages, about pages, and product pages.

faq.question: Can it improve existing copy?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the current copy, audience, page goal, and brand voice for a focused rewrite.

faq.question: Does it create CTA options?
faq.answer: Yes. It can provide multiple CTA options and explain the conversion logic behind each one.

faq.question: Does it check factual claims?
faq.answer: No. You must verify statistics, testimonials, guarantees, and legal claims before publication.

faq.question: Can it write SEO metadata?
faq.answer: Yes. It can provide page titles and meta descriptions when SEO context is relevant.

faq.question: Does it handle email or popup copy?
faq.answer: No. The skill points email sequences and popup copy to related specialized skills.
